name: architecture
description: Assess maintainability, surface unexplained implementation decisions, and evaluate design tradeoffs with an ATAM-inspired council.

interface.longDescription: Investigate maintainability with Git evidence, surface consequential decisions whose rationale needs explanation, or convene a council to evaluate implemented quality-attribute tradeoffs and proportionality.
defaultPrompt: Assess maintainability using recent Git history.
Investigate architectural friction in this subsystem.
Use $why-review to surface consequential decisions in this change whose rationale needs explanation.
Use $council to review this implemented change and its quality-attribute tradeoffs.
